evidence.quoted_text:
"cannot restore the prior definitions. The owner must "
                "install and verify the changed unit definitions against "
                "this target first: " + ", ".join(changed))
evidence.reason: The refusal message at lines 902-904 tells the owner to install and verify the changed unit definitions against the target “first,” implying a retry can then proceed. But `require_unchanged_unit_templates` still compares the prior and target Git template blobs (lines 894-898) and refuses on the same delta regardless of what systemd units were installed. Installing unit files does not change either Git tree, so the retry remains blocked. This is a concrete misleading-guidance defect; the message should state that this runbook cannot deploy a template-changing target and point to the separate owner procedure if one exists.
